text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Reunion. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ a person, maybe 40s follows Sabrina in — The Reunion still stands.
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Spoiler, The Influencer. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ Maya follows Thabo in — The Spoiler still stands.
🛡️ a man, maybe 40s follows a woman, maybe 30s, with thick glasses in — The Influencer still stands.
